text: When starting a new project, setting clear goals is essential for success. A useful method is to create SMART goals, which are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. This framework helps turn broad ideas into concrete targets that the team can actually track. Next, break these goals down into smaller milestones and clearly define the expected deliverables for each stage. These checkpoints keep the work organized and allow for regular progress reviews. Finally, ensure stakeholder alignment early on. By discussing the project’s purpose and limits with everyone involved, you avoid misunderstandings and make sure all expectations are consistent from the very beginning.
